verdict.rationale: Canny's own Autopilot feature captures feedback automatically from support, sales, call-transcript and review sources. Its native integrations keep statuses in sync with Jira, Linear, GitHub and others. Together these are product-run background automation, but only for feedback capture and sync. The MCP 'run agents that act on feedback' claim relies on external LLM tools, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: user-configurable automation rules/triggers, scheduling or recurring workflow setup, autonomy controls beyond feedback capture, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Autopilot captures feedback from support, sales, and review platforms automatically.
